outcomes.description: Provide server-side control over the lifecycle of spawned Playwright test processes, including stopping active runs.

scenarios.description: server.js POST /api/stop-test reads the module-level currentChild process reference. If no child is active, resets testRunInProgress=false and currentChild=null and returns HTTP 200 {success:true, message:'No running process found.'}. If a child exists, dispatches killProcessTree: on win32 spawns taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F; on POSIX sends SIGTERM to process group (-pid) then SIGKILL after 3000 ms. Sets currentChild=null; testRunInProgress is not reset here—deferred to the child 'close' event handler registered in the /api/run-test flow. Returns HTTP 500 {success:false, error:e.message} on exception.

actions.description: Accepts POST with no required body. Response shape: {success:boolean, message?:string, error?:string}. No authentication guard on this route.

Reads module-level currentChild (set by /api/run-test when a Playwright child is spawned). If null (no test running): sets testRunInProgress=false, currentChild=null, returns HTTP 200 {success:true, message:'No running process found.'} as a recovery path for the UI.

Calls killProcessTree(currentChild): on win32 — spawns taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F to force-kill entire process tree including browser children; on POSIX — process.kill(-pid, 'SIGTERM') targeting the process group, then setTimeout 3000 ms process.kill(-pid, 'SIGKILL'). Outer exception fallback: child.kill('SIGTERM').

Sets module-level currentChild=null after kill signal is dispatched. testRunInProgress is NOT reset here — it remains true until the child 'close' event fires (registered in the /api/run-test handler) and sets testRunInProgress=false.
On caught exception during kill sequence: logs via console.error('Error while stopping test process:', e); returns HTTP 500 {success:false, error:e.message}.

branchesAndErrors.handledAs: Terminate Playwright child process + Clear active process reference actions
